移动或复制到 keeps both established action verbs and the destination preposition. As a section heading above radio choices it is idiomatic, not a claim that the operation has started.

per_key.english: This app can offer the devices your sessions show. A device with no visible session cannot be picked yet — open Local Operator on the other computer and pull the list to refresh.
per_key.current: 本应用仅列出会话列表中可见的设备。没有可见会话的设备暂时无法选择。在另一台电脑上打开Local Operator，再下拉会话列表刷新。
per_key.linguistic_reasoning: 仅列出会话列表中可见的设备 expresses the session-derived discovery limitation, not a full network inventory. 没有可见会话…暂时无法选择 keeps the present selection restriction. 在另一台电脑上打开Local Operator，再下拉会话列表刷新 preserves the other-computer instruction, product spelling, pull gesture, list and ordering. No politeness 请 is introduced.

per_key.english: It did not answer when this computer asked.
per_key.current: 此电脑发出请求后，远程电脑未响应。
per_key.linguistic_reasoning: 此电脑发出请求后，远程电脑未响应 explicitly disambiguates the requesting relay from the nonresponding remote computer. 请求 means request; its 请 character is not the politeness marker 请 and is not a register defect. 未响应 is settled UI language rather than a calque of conversational answering.

per_key.current: 当前没有其他可见设备。
per_key.linguistic_reasoning: 当前没有其他可见设备 is a complete factual visibility statement with natural full-sentence punctuation. 当前 is a harmless temporal clarification, not a claim of absence from the network or offline status.
在此电脑上 is a natural compact location status, retaining 电脑 and 此电脑 from the adjacent catalogue rather than calling the relay a phone. The 在…上 construction matches the existing remote location label.
当前 naturally labels current state above the location. It does not turn English Right now into an urgent imperative such as 立即.
